about: The banned copy of understando. scripts/prompt.py reads this file when it renders a prompt, and `understando doctor` reads it for the docs. The rules are explained in references/copy-rules.md. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.

phrases.say: A reassurance about what does not happen. Name what the step writes in the Writes field of the Next line, once.
A slogan. Every prompt already waits for the pick.
A reassurance. Say what the control does.

phrases.pattern: \bsaved in this browser\b|\bin this browser only\b|\bstays in your browser\b
phrases.say: A reassurance. Say where the data is, only where it changes a decision.
A "no X" tacked onto an option, a question or a situation line. Put the fact in the Writes or Cost field of the Next line.
A promise about the tool. Say what the step does.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:just|simply|easily|merely|basically|essentially|obviously|of course|actually|literally|don'?t worry|do not worry|rest assured|no worries|feel free to|please note|note that|keep in mind|hassle-free|safely)\b

(?:^|[.!?]\s+)(?:in plain (?:words|terms|english)|in short|in other words|put simply|why this matters|why it matters|the bottom line|bottom line|the short version|the upshot|heads up|key takeaway|takeaway|tip|note)\s*[:.,\u2014\u2013-]
phrases.say: A run-in label. Write the sentence that the label introduces.

phrases.pattern: \bno surprises\b|\bnothing to worry about\b|\b(?:completely|totally|perfectly) safe\b|\bzero risk\b|\byou(?:'re| are) in control\b|\byou stay in control\b
